Touched-function contract:
- `mini_pkg.text.truncate`: `truncate(s, width)`
  Truncate s to at most `width` display columns, adding an ellipsis.

### tests/test_text.py (verifier tests: test_truncate_adds_ellipsis, test_truncate_short_string_unchanged)
```python
from mini_pkg.text import display_width, truncate


def test_display_width_ascii():
    assert display_width("hello") == 5


def test_truncate_short_string_unchanged():
    assert truncate("hi", 10) == "hi"


def test_truncate_adds_ellipsis():
    assert truncate("hello world", 5) == "hell\u2026"

```

Instruction under review:
---
## Goal
Restore the original behavior of `mini_pkg.text.truncate` so that it truncates a string to a given display width and appends an ellipsis when truncation occurs.

## Observable behavior
```python
assert truncate("hi", 10) == "hi"
assert truncate("hello world", 5) == "hell\u2026"
```

## Constraints
- Keep the existing API contract of `mini_pkg.text.truncate(s, width)`.
- Only modify files within scope: `mini_pkg/__init__.py`, `mini_pkg/text.py`, and `tests/test_text.py`.

## How success is measured
Run the verifier command:
```
python -m pytest -q tests/test_text.py::test_truncate_adds_ellipsis tests/test_text.py::test_truncate_short_string_unchanged
```
